title: Memdb serialization, deserialization, and store replacement

scope.rationale: These three source functions resolve a schema to a private memdb store, expose copied or borrowed database images, and replace a schema store with caller-provided bytes and ownership/resize/read-only flags. Native public APIs preserve main-schema copy/NOCOPY sizing and directly adopt replacement buffers with source-shaped capacity, resize, ownership, and read-only flags; attached-schema closure and complete differential assurance remain open.
excluded_responsibilities: Memdb file methods and delegated VFS services assigned to memdb-file-storage-locking-and-mapping
Attached schema catalog behavior outside currently supported main schema

external_source_responsibilities: Public API connection mutex and full Btree/Pager page-by-page fallback
dependencies.caller_closure: Public sqlite3_serialize/sqlite3_deserialize and backup APIs route through production Connection memory or Unix backend. Main-schema copy, NOCOPY borrow, replacement reopen, read-only mode, and FREEONCLOSE cleanup are reachable.

inputs: Connection, nullable/default schema, nullable size output, image pointer, database size, buffer capacity and ownership flags
outputs: Copied sqlite3_malloc image, borrowed private-memdb pointer, null with size, or exact result code
contracts.ownership: Copy serialization returns process-manager memory to caller. NOCOPY borrows store bytes. Deserialization transfers or borrows pData according to FREEONCLOSE and publishes no partial replacement on failure.
contracts.state_and_results: Size output begins at -1, successful schema resolution reports image size, NOCOPY succeeds only for private memdb, and deserialize sets size/capacity/max/flags before reopening schema.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Source holds connection then MemStore mutexes. Native serialized connection path uses MemoryVfs registry/store mutexes and may read Unix file bytes; no callbacks.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Invalid connection/sizes return misuse, missing schema returns null/error, OOM returns null/NOMEM, and failed replacement must preserve a closable connection and honor FREEONCLOSE exactly.

representation_differences: Private main-memory database lookup uses Connection.memory_backend instead of sqlite3_file_control plus memdb_io_methods identity.
NOCOPY now borrows the exact native main-store byte pointer and copied output uses the process memory manager.
Deserialize adopts pData directly as native store bytes, preserves szDb/szBuf, doubles process-manager reallocations up to the memdb maximum, and keeps post-replacement NOCOPY pointer identity.
Only main schema is supported; source can replace eligible attached schemas.

oracle.protocol: Native SQL frontend and C ABI integration create a database image, copy serialize with nullable size, NOCOPY borrow with exact native pointer/size, reject missing schema with size -1, deserialize a clone, enforce read-only opening, and validate negative-capacity armor. A pinned C/Zig flag/ownership differential remains open.
oracle.normalization: Database image bytes, sizes, result codes and within-worker pointer identity are exact. Absolute C/Zig addresses are not compared.

assurance.oom: Copy allocation is exercised through integration tests; direct FREEONCLOSE close, borrowed storage, read-only storage, and successful resize behavior are covered. The complete transferred-buffer failure/OOM/free matrix remains open.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Unix serialization reads a stable file in the serialized connection path. Exact connection/store lock ordering and concurrent API misuse traces remain open.
assurance.malformed_input: Negative size/capacity, null data and unknown schema have native guards; full source API-armor matrix remains open.
assurance.continuation: Successful clone and subsequent SQL pass; failure continuation and FREEONCLOSE ownership matrix remain open.
assurance.performance: NOCOPY is constant time. Copy serialization is linear; disk path reads one image rather than source page iteration.

integration.native_call_path: C ABI sqlite3_serialize/sqlite3_deserialize -> Connection memory/Unix backend -> MemoryVfs/Pager reopen
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No separate test-only image owner; backup API uses these production exports.

independent_review.notes: Requires external-buffer adoption, full flags/schema/OOM differential, assurance, and independent review.

known_blockers: Structured implementation spans, callers, callees, branches/cleanup, and upstream-test context must be recorded before promotion.
Complete the transferred-buffer failure/OOM/free differential, including resize failure and configured memdb maximum.
Support eligible attached schemas and source reopen path.
Add pinned C/Zig flags, OOM, ownership and continuation differential.
